purpose: Map the Mediterranean diet's claimed health benefits by the strength and directness of human evidence without making visual area or position imply effect size.
title: The evidence is strongest for cardiometabolic outcomes
story: Major cardiovascular events have the strongest direct endpoint-trial support, especially in adults at elevated risk compared with minimal support.
Type 2 diabetes prevention has convergent trial, cohort and biomarker evidence, although intensive programmes often combine diet, energy restriction, activity and counselling.
Mortality associations are large and consistent but not randomized; weight and metabolic-factor improvements are generally small and include randomized but surrogate risk-factor outcomes.
Cancer and dementia are mainly observational, depression is supported by small heterogeneous trials, and fatty-liver evidence is largely imaging-based with direct low-fat comparisons often similar.
observed: Corrected cardiovascular endpoint trials and comparative syntheses support reduced major events.
Randomized and prospective evidence converge for diabetes prevention.
Cohorts consistently associate adherence with lower mortality.
The largest dedicated cognitive trial was null, depression trials are small and heterogeneous, and liver studies mostly measure surrogate outcomes.
inferred: The three evidence zones are a narrative-review synthesis, not a formal GRADE table or numerical score.
Zone b groups consistent evidence that is less direct because it is observational or concerns surrogate outcomes.
Vertical position represents evidence directness and certainty, never effect size or personal benefit.
layout_notes: Use one descending evidence landscape on a white 3:2 canvas, not a dashboard: three pale horizontal zones joined by a thin vertical certainty guide at left.
Place outcome labels as aligned black text with small domain-native marks, not decorative icons; keep each mark the same visual size.

Use a solid boundary for direct randomized endpoint evidence, a dashed boundary for observational associations or surrogate and otherwise indirect outcomes, and a dotted boundary for limited evidence.
Put the reading key next to the certainty guide in quiet white space.
constraints: Arial throughout; all labels at least 19 px at a 1536 px canvas width.
Keep the title outside the artwork because this is an article figure.
Every outcome mark must be equal in size; no circle size, area or colour saturation may encode effect magnitude.
Include the uncertainty qualifier for every outcome exactly as written.
Do not imply that mortality, cancer or dementia associations are randomized effects.
Do not imply that diet alone caused results from multicomponent interventions.
